description: Tier routing heuristic for Shamwari Cloud. Edit this file and redeploy to retune routing without touching TypeScript. Validated at module load by src/router.ts and again by test/policy.test.ts, so a malformed policy fails before it can silently route everything to one tier.
notes: What is NOT here, deliberately: tier identity, provider slugs, direct provider URLs, API key bindings, and licenseClass. Those are provenance-bearing and live in src/router.ts. Rule 2 of CLAUDE.md hardcodes premium as 'restricted'; moving that into an editable file would put it one careless edit away from stamping restricted output as Mind-trainable.

Model ids are not here either. They come from the ECONOMY_MODEL and STANDARD_MODEL wrangler vars, which are already the place to change a model without a code edit. Duplicating them here would create a second source of truth.
This is a deploy-time config, not runtime-dynamic: the file is bundled into the Worker. Edit, then `wrangler deploy`.
